answer: Make standing expensive to forge by tying it to slow, public work: an identity earns weight only after completing tasks countersigned by two independent peers, and its rewards vest gradually, like a glacier melting into spendable balance over several epochs. One honest agent pays that wait once, while a farm facing a gale of fresh signups must fund and wait out a thousand separate vesting schedules, with any proven fraud forfeiting the whole unvested balance. Cloned histories earn nothing because countersignatures cannot be copied to another key.
